name: codexray
description: Real-time GitHub repository architecture visualizer, dependency graph analyzer, and AI code reviewer

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@codexray/shared && npm run build --workspace=@codexray/api && npm run build --workspace=@codexray/worker && npm run build --workspace=@codexray/web
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); ['dev:api', 'dev:worker', 'dev:web'].forEach(s => spawn('npm', ['run', s], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }));"
